title: sqlite 真实事务：ACID 原子性与回滚
expected_output:
after rollback count = 0
after commit count = 1
after failed batch count = 1
atomicity preserved (no partial row 4): True
code:
import sqlite3

con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
cur = con.cursor()
cur.execute("CREATE TABLE t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, v TEXT)")


def count():
    return cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t").fetchone()[0]


# 1) 回滚：写入被丢弃（原子性）
cur.execute("INSERT INTO t(id,v) VALUES(1,'A')")
con.rollback()
print("after rollback count =", count())

# 2) 提交：写入持久化
cur.execute("INSERT INTO t(id,v) VALUES(2,'B')")
con.commit()
print("after commit count =", count())

# 3) 一批写入中途失败 -> 整体回滚（原子性）
try:
    cur.execute("INSERT INTO t(id,v) VALUES(4,'C')")    # ok
    cur.execute("INSERT INTO t(id,v) VALUES(2,'D')")    # 主键冲突（id=2 已存在）
    con.commit()
except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
    con.rollback()
print("after failed batch count =", count())
print("atomicity preserved (no partial row 4):", count() == 1)
con.close()
